record: JOI Phase 5D synthetic execution amendment draft
purpose: Instantiate a small, controllable synthetic fixture for the frozen Phase 5D salience hypotheses without reinterpreting frozen 5C.4 or 5D findings.

source_of_truth_boundary.phase_rule: Phase 5D observes salience behavior; it does not optimize it.

factor_scope.selection_reason: These four factors can be represented explicitly in a synthetic graph without relying on unavailable historical hop, degree, score, or source-conflict metadata.

synthetic_fixture.node_and_edge_rule: Each pair uses a disjoint synthetic component. Only the declared factor differs between its two arm snapshots; all source text and unrelated metadata are held constant.
synthetic_fixture.source_text_rule: Synthetic source text is test material, not a claim about the frozen corpus or the user.
